supporting_observations.claim: From 13:36 through 13:51 UTC, FILE-PIN-01 repeatedly attempted network logons as svc-billing, generally about once per minute. The failures report bad-password status (SubStatus 0xc000006a); the records identify lsass.exe with the same process ID and source address 10.51.20.20. Domain-controller records also show corresponding credential-validation failures, and some Kerberos pre-authentication failures from that address.

The repeated failures are consistent with the supplied context that svc-billing runs a job on FILE-PIN-01 that re-authenticates every minute and that its password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC. This makes stale job credentials a plausible explanation, but the logs do not establish that the rotation or job update occurred.

At 13:20 UTC, WS-ESTONE-01 recorded explicit use of svc-billing credentials targeting PROXY-PIN-01 by taskhostw.exe. This is separate from the later FILE-PIN-01 failure pattern, and the record does not show whether the proxy authentication succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-PIN-01 were not collected from 13:25 to 14:10 UTC, so proxy activity during that interval cannot be checked against those logs.
The supplied evidence contains no job execution/configuration records, password-rotation audit, or result for the 13:20 explicit-credential event.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-billing password was actually rotated at 13:30 UTC and whether BillingSync was updated afterward.
Whether the repeated FILE-PIN-01 failures were generated by the expected BillingSync job or by another process running under the same host context.
Whether the 13:20 svc-billing credential use from WS-ESTONE-01 to PROXY-PIN-01 succeeded or was authorized.
Whether any successful svc-billing authentication or malicious activity occurred outside the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the svc-billing password-rotation audit and BillingSync update or configuration history around 13:30 UTC.
Correlate FILE-PIN-01 process/service telemetry for PID 0x144c with the BillingSync job during the failure period.
Retrieve any available proxy-side records or endpoint/network telemetry to determine the outcome and context of the 13:20 event from WS-ESTONE-01.
Review domain authentication records for successful svc-billing logons during the scoped period.
